title.zh: 授予伊洛伊洛省Janiuay市镇政府在该市镇经营电灯、热力与动力系统特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act Granting the “Municipal Government of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo” a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act Granting the “Municipal Government of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo” a Franchise for an Electric Light, Heat and Power System in Said Municipality
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho “Municipal Government of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo” để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại Philippines
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ “Municipal Government of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo” เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในฟิลิปปินส์
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada “Municipal Government of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo” untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Filipina
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada “Municipal Government of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo” untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Filipina

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1947/ra_195_1947.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and to the provisions of the Constitution, there is granted to the "Municipal Government of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo." For a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege, and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and/or power system for sale within the limits of the municipality of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo.
The franchise granted to Janiuay Electric Light Co., Inc., by the municipality of Janiuay to operate an electric light, heat and/or power system in said municipality, is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1947.
